title: Effect of Rosuvastatin on Triglyceride Levels in Mexican Hypertriglyceridemic Patients

sections.abstract:
The primary purpose of this trial is to determine if the treatment with rosuvastatin 10 and 20mg/day during 8 weeks in hypertriglyceridemic patients will reduce their triglyceride levels.

Posted outcomes: Change (Reduction) in Triglycerides Levels From Baseline to End of Treatment (Week 8). timeframe=8 weeks. Rosuvastatin 10 mg=67.95 (±128.46); Rosuvastatin 20 mg=78.61 (±121.51); Placebo=22.31 (±120.54)
